subject: Two-part demo proposal to accommodate CTO late arrival
messages:
From: Lily Chen <lily.chen@brightworks.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:13:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo next Thurs — CTO travel update

Hi Laura,

Quick update from our side: Alex (our CTO) had his flight rebooked and now won't land until 11:30pm the night before the demo. He still wants to join if we can keep a short executive portion, but he's only available for a focused 20–30 minute slot right after his arrival (essentially late evening). The rest of the product/technical audience will attend during normal business hours.

Is there any way we can split the session into two short blocks — a late exec check-in when Alex lands, and a more in-depth technical walkthrough earlier in the day with our engineering leads? If splitting isn't workable, can we rearrange so the exec Q&A is first thing the next morning?

Attaching Alex's itinerary so you can see the arrival time. Let me know what works and we'll lock calendar availability on our side.

Thanks,
Lily Chen
Senior Product Manager, BrightWorks
[lily.chen@brightworks.com]

[Attachment: cto_itinerary.pdf (pdf, 48KB)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Lily Chen <lily.chen@brightworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:41:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Demo next Thurs — Two-part option that is workable for Redwood

Hi Lily — thanks for the heads up and for sending Alex's itinerary. Splitting is workable and honestly preferable for this account so we can tailor the time and level of detail for each audience. Proposed approach below:

1) Technical deep-dive (45 minutes) — scheduled during your engineering slot: 10:00–10:45 AM PT
   - Attendees: BrightWorks Eng leads + Redwood SRE and integration engineer (Karthik)
   - Focus: architecture, integration plan, latency/cost expectations, and a short live run of the integration checklist

2) Executive Q&A (25 minutes) — late evening exec check-in aligned to Alex's arrival: 11:45 PM–12:10 AM PT (same calendar day)
   - Attendees: Alex (CTO), your product leadership, Laura (me) and Marissa (AE)
   - Focus: business outcomes, rollout timeline, and high-level SLAs

Fallback: if Alex is delayed further, Karthik can run the 25-minute exec slot and cover the most critical decision items so you don't lose momentum.

I've attached a compact two-part agenda for both sessions. If the times above look OK, I'll send two calendar invites (clearly labeled as "Technical — BrightWorks" and "Exec Q&A — BrightWorks (late)"), and Marissa will follow up with materials we should circulate in advance.

Two quick asks:
- Confirm Alex can make the 11:45–12:10 slot; if not, what is the latest possible window we should hold?
- Share any specific exec-level topics Alex wants covered (e.g., data residency, SLA commitments, SSO/KMS).

Will hold tentative slots for now.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

[Attachment: proposed_agenda_two-slot.pdf (pdf, 32KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Demo next Thurs — coverage note

Laura / Marissa — I can take the exec portion if Alex is delayed past midnight. I'll prep a 20-minute decision-focused brief that hits SLAs, failover options, and expected cost impact of the proposed integration. Will also have a short slide for handoff to the AM for next steps. Standby and can jump in remotely.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
[karthik_iyer@redwood.com]

From: Lily Chen <lily.chen@brightworks.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Alex Park <alex.park@brightworks.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Demo next Thurs — confirmed two-part approach

Laura — this looks great, thanks for the quick turnaround. Alex sees the 11:45 PM–12:10 AM window as acceptable and he'll join if on time; we've also told him you'll be prepared to proceed without him if needed. We've confirmed engineering for the morning slot (10:00–10:45).

Please go ahead and send the two calendar invites and include Zoom links (we'll prefer recording for the technical session). Also: Alex asked that you highlight any migration timeline constraints and whether Redwood supports a phased rollout with a read-only initial phase — could you include that in the exec notes?

Lily
Senior Product Manager, BrightWorks
[lily.chen@brightworks.com]
